message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 121, "amount_cents": 5261}, {"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to verify Alpha's refund work against the ledger rather than trust the handoff message. I'll start by listing the refunds.
The refunds ledger matches Alpha's handoff exactly. Next I'll list the orders to check that these refunds line up with real orders before I compute any balances.

The refunds match Alpha's handoff, and each refunded order exists and its refund is smaller than the order amount, so nothing looks wrong. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance is 31368 (orders 120 and 123 total 31368, with no refunds against them). Refunds match the ledger and each refunded order exists, so I'll continue with birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 14737 matches the orders (121 and 124 total 21083) minus the refunds (5261 and 1085). Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance next.

I checked the refunds against the orders and each customer's net balance: acme 31368, birch 21083-6346=14737, cobalt 29756-5470=24286. All match, so Alpha's refund work looks complete and correct. I'll record acme's payout first.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch's net balance of 14737 matches orders 121 and 124 (21083) minus refunds 5261 and 1085, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme (31368) and birch (14737) are already recorded. Cobalt's net balance of 24286 matches orders 122 and 125 (29756) minus refund 5470, so I'll record that payout now.
All three payouts recorded successfully. I rechecked the totals: acme 5706+25662=31368, birch 8002+13081-5261-1085=14737, cobalt 7562+22194-5470=24286. All match the recorded amounts.
